text: Agents are autonomous units that perform tasks and make decisions based on role and goal
quote: an "Agent" is an autonomous unit that can: Perform specific tasks, Make decisions based on its role and goal

text: Agents can use tools to accomplish their objectives
quote: In the CrewAI framework, an `Agent` is an autonomous unit that can: * Perform specific tasks * Make decisions based on its role and goal * Use tools to accomplish objectives

text: Tasks are assignments given to an agent with description, responsible agent, and required tools specified
quote: a "Task" is a specific assignment completed by an "Agent". Tasks provide all necessary details for execution, such as a description, the agent responsible, required tools

text: Supports sequential or hierarchical process strategies for orchestrating multi-agent task execution
quote: process = Process.sequential # or Process.hierarchical

text: Flows let you build structured, event-driven workflows that connect tasks, manage state, and control execution
quote: Flows allow you to create structured, event-driven workflows. They provide a seamless way to connect multiple tasks, manage state, and control the flow of execution

text: Provides a unified Memory system with adaptive-depth recall using composite scoring of semantic similarity, recency, and importance
quote: CrewAI provides a unified memory system -- a single Memory class... supports adaptive-depth recall with composite scoring that blends semantic similarity, recency, and importance

text: Memory system uses an LLM to analyze and categorize saved content, inferring scope, categories, and importance
quote: Memory uses an LLM to analyze content when saving (inferring scope, categories, and importance) and supports adaptive-depth recall with composite scoring

text: Built-in tools give agents capabilities like web search, data analysis, and delegating tasks to other agents
quote: CrewAI tools empower agents with capabilities ranging from web searching and data analysis to collaboration and delegating tasks among coworkers

text: Integrates with multiple LLM providers via their native SDKs so you can pick different models
quote: CrewAI integrates with multiple LLM providers through providers native sdks, giving you the flexibility to choose the right model for your specific use case

text: Official CrewAI CLI lets you create, train, run, and manage crews and flows
quote: The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows

text: crewai test CLI command runs the crew for a set number of iterations and reports performance metrics
quote: We added the CLI command crewai test to make it easy to test your crew. This command will run your crew for a specified number of iterations and provide detailed performance metrics

text: Agents support an mcps field for direct MCP tool integration, via string or structured configs
quote: Use the mcps field directly on agents for seamless MCP tool integration. The DSL supports both string references... and structured configurations

text: Performance monitoring tracks agent execution times, token usage, and resource consumption
quote: Performance Monitoring: Track agent execution times, token usage, and resource consumption

text: Visual Agent Builder lets you design and test agents without writing code
quote: CrewAI AMP includes a Visual Agent Builder that simplifies agent creation and configuration without writing code. Design your agents visually and test them in real-time.

text: Visual Task Builder supports drag-and-drop task creation, dependency visualization, and real-time testing
quote: The Visual Task Builder enables: Drag-and-drop task creation, Visual task dependencies and flow, Real-time testing and validation

text: Deploy crews to managed infrastructure with a few clicks
quote: Deploy your crews to a managed infrastructure with a few clicks

text: Install the crewai CLI via a single command (uv tool install crewai)
quote: Run the following command to install crewai CLI: uv tool install crewai

text: A Crew is a collaborative group of agents working together on a set of tasks, defining collaboration/execution strategy
quote: A crew in crewAI represents a collaborative group of agents working together to achieve a set of tasks. Each crew defines the strategy for task execution, agent collaboration, and the overall workflow.

text: Flows combine and coordinate coding tasks and Crews into sophisticated AI automations
quote: Flows allow developers to combine and coordinate coding tasks and Crews efficiently, providing a robust framework for building sophisticated AI automations.

text: YAML configuration lets you version control agent settings and switch between different models
quote: The YAML configuration allows you to: * Version control your agent settings * Easily switch between different models

text: CLI can scaffold a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project
quote: Create a new crew, flow, tool, skill, or template project.

text: Older CLI commands remain functional but emit a deprecation warning
quote: These older commands still work but print a yellow deprecation warning.

text: Deployed crews can be monitored in real time on managed infrastructure
quote: Deploy your crews to a managed infrastructure and monitor their execution in real-time.

text: Webhook streaming pushes real-time events and updates to external systems
quote: Stream real-time events and updates to your systems

text: Provides tracing & observability to monitor agents and workflows with metrics, logs, and traces
quote: Tracing & Observability: Monitor and track your AI agents and workflows in real-time, including metrics, logs, and traces.

text: Framework gives autonomous multi-agent collaboration via Crews and precise event-driven control via Flows
quote: It gives developers autonomous agent collaboration through Crews and precise, event-driven control through Flows.

text: Deployed crews are accessible via a REST API for integration with existing systems
quote: Deploy your crews to a managed infrastructure with a few clicks... Access your deployed crews via REST API for integration with existing systems

text: Crew Studio offers a no-code/low-code interface to create and customize crews
quote:
Crew Studio

Create and customize crews using a no-code/low-code interface

text: Tool Repository lets you publish and install tools to extend crew capabilities
quote:
Tool Repository

Publish and install tools to enhance your crews’ capabilities
